tabs.propIncidentTable: Allow Instana to send events to the ServiceNow incident table
tabs.propIncidentTableDesc: After propagating the IBM Instana intermediate table, Instana updates the incident table in ServiceNow. This opens and closes ServiceNow incidents in sync with Instana's incidents as well as syncing notes and activity between Instana and ServiceNow. Any existing business rules to modify your incident table in ServiceNow will also function normally.
tabs.restIncidentTable: Restrict Instana to intermediate table propagation only
tabs.restIncidentTableDesc: Instana only propagates incident data to the IBM Instana intermediate table without any further updates to the ServiceNow incident table. To enable the full syncing of events, notes, and activities, you will need to update your ServiceNow business rules. For details, see the <documentationLink>documentation</documentationLink>.
